name: Fresh Fish Delivery
description: Pick up the fresh fish from the fish shop and bring it to the bakery.

start.text: Hey there! I just caught some fresh fish and I need someone to deliver it to the bakery. Can you help me out?
Great! Just pick up the fish from the fish shop and bring it to the bakery. Thanks!

complete.text: Thanks for delivering the fish! I really appreciate it.

name: Catnip Run
description: Pick up the catnip from Big Chungus's house and bring it to the hospital.

start.text: Hey there! The hospital needs catnip urgently. Big Chungus has some at his place. Can you pick it up?
Great! Grab the catnip from Big Chungus's house and bring it straight to the hospital. Thanks!

complete.text: Thanks for bringing the catnip! The hospital really needed it.

name: Midnight Snack
description: Ollie has the munchies. Grab a fish from the shop and bring it back to him.

start.text: Kiki! I've got the worst case of the midnight munchies. Could you run to the fish shop and grab me a nice fresh fish?
It's the middle of the day, Ollie...
Don't judge me. Just get the fish, please!

complete.text: Oh wow, that smells amazing! You're the best, Kiki!
Try to leave some for tomorrow, please.

name: Rescue Mr. Whiskers
description: Ollie's toy mouse rolled into the haunted house. Someone has to go get it.

start.text: Kiki, have you seen Mr. Whiskers? My toy mouse! I think it rolled into the haunted house and I'm too scared to go get it.
You named your toy mouse Mr. Whiskers?
He has a very distinguished personality. Will you please go get him?

complete.text: Mr. Whiskers! You're safe! Thank you so much, Kiki, I was so worried.
He was just sitting by the front door. I don't think the haunted house is actually haunted.
Kiki, please don't ruin this for me.

name: Catnip Cookies
description: Bakercat is baking catnip cookies but needs a fresh supply from the hospital.

start.text: Hello! I'm baking a special batch of catnip cookies today but I've run out of catnip. The hospital keeps some in their supply room.
It's the finest grade! Only the best for my cookies. Could you fetch some from the hospital and bring it to the bakery?

complete.text: Perfect! These cookies are going to be legendary. Here, take one as thanks!
Oh, these are actually really good!
Of course they are. I'm a professional.
